deviations_from_card: Three commits, not four: the red test commit already carries the sweeps (cases 4, 5, 6), so there is no separate closing test(linga) commit. The red commit (4a918f39) is red on the repo gate by design (cases 1-6 fail; case 5 and 6 also need activity.ts). tools/linga-rules-test.cjs is the only suite touched, already wired into test:rules, so no desk/package.json edit and no lock taken. view.ts lingaHome and progressDots are unchanged: both already decide the same thing the owner decides (the parked check shows as check-part-way once the scene is finished or none is live), so only phonePanel and activeCheck read ownerOf/checkAt there. The check table has 12 states, not 10: 'parked' is added (a check under a scene takes only leave, carry on and hear again), and the card's 'about preparing' is about-empty while a call in flight is 'reading'.
notes: Behaviour a user could see beyond the card's list: (1) check-reveal on a non-listening task now answers 409 instead of 400 (same sentence). (2) check-answer, check-task, plan-goal, plan-swap, plan-add, plan-renew and plan-agree outside their state now answer 409 with a sentence from checkRefusal; before, the stage guards gave 409 or 400 depending on the guard. (3) check-retry is refused with 409 in about-asked, say, listen, choose, verdict, plan-goal and plan-topics (before: 200, no change); no screen offered it there. (4) plan-add is still accepted in the empty plan (the phone's Add this topic box is drawn there), plan-renew too; both are refused while the topic question is asked. (5) The view now draws any check action the table would refuse as disabled, including home's Carry on (check-resume) while a parked or kept check still has a call in flight; before it was drawn enabled and the server answered 409. (6) Starting or resuming a scene, or pressing pause on a paused scene, parks any kept check: the check is not lost, home reads Carry on (check-part-way) once the scene is finished, and a stale phone sending a check command to a parked check gets 409 'Your conversation is on the desk'. (7) check-start, plan-propose, plan-open and check-resume now pause a live scene with Leave's own fields (pending cleared, so a late opening or reply is dropped by its token), and level-self mid-scene does not (unchanged; out of the card). (8) A late result for a parked check no longer moves the TV to a check screen (commit ignores the screen while parked). Disagreement with the scout: lingaHome left as is, see deviations. A paused scene with a kept unparked check still shows home 'resume' while the phone holds the check, as before the card (the 2026-09-25 owner decision for the check-first phone is kept: case 7 guard). No TV capture ran: the TV edit is one line in LingaTV.tsx (lc reads ownerOf), no screen drawing changed, and the gates were the rules suites and tsc; LingaPhone.tsx's only change is reading activeCheck(s) for the same value. A saved session needs no migration: LevelCheck.parked is optional and absent on every check saved before.
